items.headline: Jalen Hurts throws 3 TD passes and Eagles stuff Commanders' late 2-point try for 24-22 win
items.description: — Jalen Hurts threw for 203 yards and three touchdowns, and the Eagles' Moro Ojomo stuffed the Commanders' attempt at a tying 2-point conversion with 1:01 remaining as Philadelphia squeaked past Washington 24-22 on Sunday.
